newsitem.title: UK: Tomkins to buy U.S. Strant for 372 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Tomkins to buy U.S. Strant for 372 mln stg.

text.p: UK engineering-to-baking combine Tomkins Plc said on Wednesday that it has agreed to buy U.S. firm Stant Corp for 372 million pounds ($604.7 million).
It said in a statement that a tender offer for all Stant's shares will be launched at $21.50 per share in cash, valuing Stant's equity at $406 million.
Tomkins will also assume Stant's estimated debt of around 200 million pounds ($325.1 million) and will fund the purchase from its cash resources.
The company said that Bessemer Capital Partners LP of New York, which owns 56.9 percent of Stant, had agreed to tender its shares to Tomkins.

"Stant expands our product offering to the automotive original equipment market and increases the range and volume of products we can distribute through Gates Rubber Company," said Tomkins' chairman Greg Hutchings.
Tomkins said it was confident that the purchase would enhance earnings.
Stant, which employs over 7,000 people, manufactures automotive wind-shielding systems, wiper blades, closure caps and engine thermostats.
